tools.name: find_place
tools.description:
Resolve a place name or address to coordinates, best match first.

Useful when a name is ambiguous (several Springfields) and the right candidate must be
chosen before calling another tool. A city resolves to its centre as OpenStreetMap maps it.
Geocoding by OpenStreetMap Nominatim, ODbL.

tools.description:

Includes the latest full year of ERA5 reanalysis, a single year named in each layer's year
field rather than a multi-year normal (hottest day, coldest night, hot and frost day counts,

tools.name: get_hazards_near
tools.description:
Disasters and hazards happening now or recently near a place, most severe and most recent first.

Wildfires (NASA FIRMS), earthquakes, floods, tropical cyclones, volcanic eruptions and droughts

tools.name: get_country_profile
tools.description:
A country's climate and disaster risk from the Criora Atlas.

Overall risk score and class, and scores for climate, nature, social, governance and adaptation,
with the country's income group and region. With include_indicators=true, about 160 indicators
(INFORM Risk Index, ND-GAIN, World Bank) each

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description:
Several countries side by side on overall risk and each risk dimension, with their ranks.

Scores run 0 to 100; higher means more risk. Ranks are among all countries in the Criora Atlas,
1 being the highest risk.

tools.name: assess_place

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "find_place" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Resolve a place name or address to coordinates, best match first. Useful when a name is ambiguous (several Springfields) and the right candidate must be chosen …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
